# Changelog Instructions

When making changes to this project, update `CHANGELOG.md` with your changes.

## Format

Follow [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/) format:

```markdown
## [VERSION] - YYYY-MM-DD

### Added
- New features

### Changed
- Changes to existing functionality

### Fixed
- Bug fixes

### Removed
- Removed features
```

## Rules

1. Add entries under `[Unreleased]` section during development
2. Move unreleased changes to a versioned section when releasing
3. Keep descriptions high-level and user-focused
4. Group related changes together
5. Most recent version at the top
